}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4S", "RPI-CM4S-R2" and "Made in the UK" are silkscreened on board top.
{{See also|RPF Raspberry Pi series}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Broadcom]] BCM2711 @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A72) *GPU: [[Broadcom]] VideoCore VI @500MHz :OpenGL ES 3.1, Vulkan 1.0, :H.265 (HEVC) (up to 4Kp60 decode), :H.264 (up to 1080p60 decode, 1080p30 encode) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Power Source: 5V via connectors
